description: Skills assessment rules of an Australian assessing authority (TRA, ACS, VETASSESS, Engineers Australia, ANMAC, CPA Australia, CAANZ, IPA, ACECQA and others), checked against the authority's official pages: who each program is for, qualification, work experience (years, hours, recency), English, fees, processing time, exclusions and common misconceptions. For TRA it covers MSA, PSA, Job Ready, OSAP and TSS, and with occupation (and passportCountry) says which apply. Pass occupation alone to look up its authority and pathways. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

authority.description: Assessing authority code or name, e.g. "TRA", "ACS", "VETASSESS", "Engineers Australia".

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

passportCountry.description: Passport country in English, e.g. "China", "India". TRA decides OSAP / TSS by passport.

name: get_skill_assessment_rules
title: Get skills assessment rules
